capabilities.description: Report drawable canvas dimensions; refit when following; session only, preserves physics/history

preconditions: Ordinary revision/document guards and retry retention apply
effects: Session presentation only; preserves graph, physics/run/time/charge, history and document dirty state
snapshot.viewport exposes measured width_px/height_px, registered, following and optional fit_failure; no OS window resize is requested
width_px and height_px are both required finite numbers within 64–100000; identical size does not recompute fit
When following, size changes recompute complete schematic bounds using existing view.fit semantics; manual views keep their center/zoom
If a valid reported size cannot fit above .01 zoom, accept the measured size, preserve the last view and expose fit_failure=view-limit; a later larger size retries
Native publication is deferred past paint, coalesced while pending and guarded by captured revision/generation; stale reports retry from a later frame without overwriting navigation

errors.when: Nonfinite or out-of-range dimensions, missing required size, malformed fields or non-boolean follow_viewport
Document or command revision changed before this report/navigation

completion.mode: immediate shared view/state update; no background solver job

mutation_preconditions.combination: A revision guard is required; all supplied revision/document guards must match
mutation_preconditions.expected_command_revision: Guards admitted commands, including other actors; live solver publication does not invalidate it
mutation_preconditions.expected_document_generation: Optional mutation context guard; prevents applying an old rendered action to a replacement document, including background publication
mutation_preconditions.expected_revision: Guards all state publication, including live samples

discovery.retry_retention: Latest 256 successful mutation keys per session; reconnect to the same process preserves them. Expired keys have no deduplication guarantee.

checks: saved view survives open; following and measured size stay session-only
